en-US.title: Sucker! Battle Dice
en-US.subtitle: Dice Duels With a Twist
en-US.description:
Roll, strategize, and outplay your opponent in Sucker! Battle Dice — a turn-based dice game where every scorecard decision matters.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Challenge a friend in asynchronous multiplayer
• Play solo against the computer
• Roll five dice and build the strongest scorecard
• Spend Sucker Tokens on Extra Rolls, Mulligans, and Sucker Punches
• Send canned taunts at just the right moment
• Track completed games and head-to-head stats

Games are turn-based, so you can play whenever you have time. Push notifications let you know when your opponent is waiting.

No ads. No in-app purchases. Account deletion is available directly from Profile.
en-US.releaseNotes: The first official App Store release of Sucker! Battle Dice. Play solo or challenge a friend, use Sucker Tokens, and track your stats.
en-US.promoText: Roll the dice, spend your Sucker Tokens wisely, and outplay a friend in an asynchronous duel.
